variant_decisions.evidence: Qere אַתְּ and ketiv אתי are the same independent pronoun (lemma 859 b), tagged HPp2fs in both; the ketiv simply writes a final yod on the archaic form of the 2fs pronoun. ASV "Arise, I pray thee, and disguise thyself, that thou be not known to be the wife of Jeroboam" renders either identically, and no note is mapped here. The qere base stands.

variant_decisions.evidence: Qere שִׁישַׁ֥ק and ketiv שושק are the same proper name (lemma 7895), tagged Np in both, differing in the vowel letter: yod in the qere, waw in the ketiv. As at 1KI.16.34, the difference survives transliteration — the ASV reads "Shishak king of Egypt", carrying the qere's i, where the ketiv consonants would give Shoshak (the form behind the LXX's Σουσακιμ). The name distinguishes the qere.
